name: 2c8202d570c0
claim: lan_peer_assign.py flush-outbox reads PEER_PORTAL_TLS_ENABLED, PEER_CA_FILE, PEER_CA_SHA256 and ORAMA_CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN from os.environ, not .env.local; export them before a flush or every item stays queued with invalid PEER_CA_SHA256.

decisions.notes: Flush attempts without exported TLS vars fell back to HTTP and stripped the bearer token; exporting them made TLS verification pass.

rationale: The scheduled coord-pulse runs flush-outbox without sourcing .env.local, so TLS variables must be exported in the same shell or by the launcher.
